name: KIMANI
tagline: A private global members club offering seamless digital access to trusted local experts
description: KIMANI is a premium digital concierge and private members club designed for ultra-high-net-worth individuals. The platform connects members with a curated global network of local experts to facilitate luxury travel, hospitality, and lifestyle services. Founded by the veteran behind LVH Global, the company leverages deep industry relationships to provide exclusive access and bespoke experiences through a proprietary mobile interface.

founders.name: Amir Benesh
founders.bio: Founder of LVH Global, a luxury hospitality platform with approximately $50M ARR. Experienced operator building trusted relationships with UHNW clients.

updates.title: Campaign Launch
updates.body: Official launch of the KIMANI community-driven fundraise to scale our digital expert network.

highlights: Founded by luxury hospitality veteran Amir Benesh
Targeting the UHNW market with high-margin memberships
Proprietary digital platform for global concierge services

name: Pranos.ai
tagline: Transforming vehicular communication by converting vehicle windows into digital displays
description: Pranos.ai develops advanced hardware that transforms ordinary car windows into high-definition transparent digital displays. This technology allows for outdoor advertising and peer-to-peer communication directly from vehicles. As a Y Combinator alum, Pranos is targeting the massive out-of-home advertising market by turning existing vehicle fleets into mobile billboards.

founders.name: David Astoria
founders.bio: Forbes Contributor and former co-owner at Grabbit (YC S18). Advisor for Korean government-backed startups.

updates.title: Customer Milestone
updates.body: Surpassed 900+ signups with a daily growth rate of 30 new users.

name: Tucktec
description: Tucktec manufactures a patented hard-shell kayak that folds flat in just minutes, making water recreation accessible for city dwellers and travelers without roof racks. Since its inception, the company has sold over 50,000 units, proving significant market demand for portable outdoor gear. Each kayak is manufactured in the USA, emphasizing durability and user-friendly design.

founders.name: Dan Norton
founders.bio: Laser and Holographic inventor and patent holder. Lead designer behind the Tucktec folding mechanism.

updates.title: 50,000 Units Sold
updates.body: Tucktec reached a major milestone of 50,000 kayaks sold worldwide.

highlights: Patented design, 100% Made in the USA

name: Ronald Isley Liquid Gold
tagline: Invest in Ronald Isley's award-winning spirits brand
description: Ronald Isley Liquid Gold is a celebrity-backed spirits brand co-founded by legendary recording artist Ronald Isley of the Isley Brothers. The company focuses on premium spirits, including award-winning brandy and vodka, leveraging Ronald Isley's massive cultural influence and social media reach. The brand aims to disrupt the luxury alcohol market by combining high-quality distillation with celebrity lifestyle branding.

founders.name: Ronald Isley
founders.bio: Grammy-award winning lead vocalist of The Isley Brothers with over six decades in the entertainment industry.

updates.title: Strategic Expansion
updates.body: Expanding distribution for our premium brandy and spirits line across the US.

highlights: Co-founded by R&B legend Ronald Isley
Leverages 4.8 million combined social media followers
Award-winning spirits profile in the premium segment

name: Minds
tagline: The social network that you own
description: Minds is a decentralized social networking platform focused on Internet freedom, privacy, and user ownership. Unlike traditional social media, Minds rewards users with crypto tokens for their contributions and utilizes open-source software to ensure transparency. With a community of over 5 million members, it represents a leading alternative to centralized Big Tech platforms.

founders.name: Bill Ottman
founders.bio: Leading voice in alternative social media, featured on Joe Rogan, Wired, and NPR for his work on decentralization.

updates.title: 5 Million Members
updates.body: Reached a significant milestone of 5 million registered members on the decentralized platform.

highlights: Open-source codebase with a focus on free speech
